item.title: Countdown to 2034 Winter Olympics in Salt Lake City begins: What to know
item.description: Utah is preparing to host the 2034 Winter Olympic Games, an event officials expect will draw participants from 100 countries. The state is currently in the early stages of a years-long planning process led by the local Olympic organizing committee.

item.title: How much do immigrants pay in taxes?
item.description: Foreign-born New Yorkers contribute significantly to the state's economy, paying billions in taxes and fees, and the New York for All Act seeks to protect these contributions by preventing state and local agencies from cooperating with federal immigration enforcement.

item.title: FDA Recalls: CHIPS AHOY! snack, a Gerber baby food and other baby food for toxins, choking hazards
item.description: Gerber, CHIPS AHOY! and Tippy Toes have all issued recalls due to various manufacturing issues ranging from choking hazards to the potential presence of toxins.

item.title: Peter Attia departs CBS News after communications with Epstein surface
item.description: Wellness and anti-aging doctor Peter Attia is leaving CBS News after communications he had with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein were brought to light, The Hill confirmed on Monday.
